description_en: We present one of the rarest investment and residential opportunities in one of the capital's most prestigious projects – Platinum Tower, a modern 35-storey tower that is rising in the heart of the Artificial Lake area. This iconic development combines contemporary architecture with the highest construction standards, offering apartments designed for maximum comfort, natural lighting and stunning panoramic views over Lake Park and the city of Tirana. Main advantages: - Elite location: near the Artificial Lake Park, in one of the greenest and most sought-after areas of Tirana; - Modern architecture & quality construction: 35-story tower with European-level technology and materials; - Panoramic view: each apartment enjoys natural light and an impressive view over the nature of the capital city; - Premium Services: professional administration, 24/7 security, commercial spaces and recreational facilities within the complex; - Platinum Tower is the ideal choice for those looking for a luxurious lifestyle or a safe investment in Tirana's growing real estate market; - Premium Apartment 2+1+2 in Platinum Tower - Floor 17 A luxurious and modern apartment for sale in one of the most prestigious towers of Tirana - Platinum Tower, 35 floors, near the Artificial Lake Park. Apartment details: 17th (seventeenth) floor Net area: 147 m² Gross area: 191 m² Interior layout: Spacious and bright living room with large panoramic windows; 2 comfortable bedrooms; 2 toilets; 1 balcony/veranda with a fantastic view over the city and the Lake Park; This apartment is a unique opportunity for elite housing and a guaranteed investment in one of the most iconic projects of the capital! For more information, please contact!
